markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk [F1]; ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 stains are drafted pending confirmation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong invasive score; 5% dataset ECE |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% test coverage, CI 76%–98%) | Single class; dataset-level coverage guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Atypical OOD, high reliability; 70% AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (70%–78% similarity) [F5]; InSitu contrast 62% (BACH_0046) | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (-2.02, +1.30 contribution; 18/20 spot check, caption mismatch) [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 4, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.98, +1.18 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce stroma (-0.98 score, +0.89 contribution; 20/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor cell density** (regions 0, 4, 9) · context · 2382/mm² (93rd percentile) [F7]; TILs 92nd [F9], nuclear shape 90th [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (mean +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier drivers (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade in situ carcinoma mimics invasion where tubules and stroma are scarce (nearest contrast: InSitu BACH_0046, 62% similarity).
- Sampled nuclei segmentation (regions 0, 4, 9; 15/21 AI spot check) or small validation cohort (132 cases) misrepresents slide.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 9, 2**: Highest risk scores (100%); confirm true stromal invasion rather than in situ carcinoma.
2. **Region 7**: Verify absent tubule formation and lost benign stroma versus InSitu contrast case BACH_0046.
3. **Regions 3, 4, 11**: Manually check stromal infiltration, pleomorphism, and mitoses (model mitotic score is unreliable).
